ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly asymmetrical; approximately 75% low-intensity (dark) pixels vs 25% high-intensity (white) pixels, with the majority of white pixels concentrated at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity (black) block centered around the median notch; high-contrast white mottling and 'splash' patterns located at the far left and far right distal margins; distinctive white circular rings (approx. coordinates mid-left and upper-right).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped depression; calculated interior angle approximately 15 degrees; notch depth is roughly 8% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing boundary; extreme serration density on the right lobe tip; smoother, lower-amplitude variations approaching the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a gentle convex arc from the notch toward the tips; leading edges (visible at tips) exhibit an upward-sweeping concave curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of roughly 3-5 circular high-contrast rings on the mid-left lobe surface; similar individual circular pixel disruptions on the upper-right lobe near the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the left lobe vertically and the right lobe diagonally; distinct dark linear 'scratches' cutting through the lighter pigmented regions at the tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both lobes; the distal tip of the right lobe appears highly irregular and jagged, suggesting minor tissue loss or structural damage.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark, forked 'Y-shaped' pigment mark located within the high-intensity white field on the left lobe.
